name: .411 Cal-250gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist for Dangerous Game hunting is 1-19″ or faster. Minimum Required twist for Big Game hunting is 1-22″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game or Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "At 250gr this pure copper projectile will get the old 405 Winchester up to about 2600 fps. With the 4mm hollow point this Stone Hammer™ is suited for any of the 405 Winchester rifles, including the lever action."
